text:
elaine_support: FYI — ACME (customer org) reporting users hit 403 when opening a project in the console right after SSO onboarding. Repro + logs below.

sam_irwin: Can you drop a quick repro and a sanitized token/header? Need to reproduce locally.

elaine_support: Repro steps:
1) Invite user via IdP (Okta) -> accept invite
2) User can see org in left nav but clicking project shows "You don't have permission (403)"
3) Sample API hit: 
```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\ \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/PRJ456
# => 403 response: {\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"message\":\"User missing project role\"}
```

morgan_prod: From platform logs the IdP id_token payload for user shows: `groups: [\"acme-engineers\"]`, `roles: \"project_viewer\"` but our claim-mapper only assigns project roles when `project_claim` pattern matches (e.g., `project:PRJ456:role`). Looks like the IdP trimmed the claim to generic `project_viewer`.

kevin_sre: This is a common fallout when IdP attribute pruning is enabled (Okta shortens/sanitizes custom attribute values during bulk provisioning). Two short-term options: 1) force SCIM group sync -> updates membership mapping; 2) assign project role via admin API as a workaround.

elaine_support: Workaround used and verified:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/ORG123/projects/PRJ456/members
Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {\"email\":\"jane@acme.com\",\"role\":\"project.viewer\"}
# returns 200 and user can open project immediately
```

sam_irwin: I can also kick an SSO resync for that org. Internal endpoint: `POST /internal/sso/resync?org=ORG123` — will queue a job and fetch SCIM groups again.
\
deploy-bot: resync job queued (id=r-job-9982) — started.

morgan_prod: Resync logs: SCIM groups fetched but 3 group attributes were truncated on ingest due to a 64-char limit in the claim parser. Filed ENG ticket ENG-IAM-1898.

kevin_sre: Long-term fix: increase attribute length and accept raw group IDs (avoid human-friendly name mapping). Short-term: support can continue to attach project role until patch deploys. Also advise users to fully logout/login so id_token is refreshed (tokens cached in session otherwise).

elaine_support: Created INC-8421 for the customer, documented steps and temporary grant (24h admin window) so they can finish onboarding. Customer notified.

sam_irwin: ENG pushed a staging patch that relaxes group name length check. Plan to promote to prod in next maintenance window. Keep thread open until customer confirms.

morgan_prod: Customer confirmed they regained access after manual role assign + full logout/login. Support marks as resolved from our side. :tada:

kevin_sre: Added notes to run a quick audit: `GET /v1/orgs/ORG123/memberships?filter=unmapped_groups` to find any orphaned group members post-resync.

elaine_support: Thanks all — will close after prod roll and one verification call with ACME.
